start.text: Hi! Rent a scooter or motorbike in a few taps: pick dates, pay by QR and pick it up.

language.changed: I'll write in English from now on. Use the buttons below to see your bookings and return dates.

hint.text: Open the app to rent a bike and manage your bookings.

receipt.rent: Rent, {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}

client.docs: Booking {code}: documents are not uploaded yet. Please upload your passport and licence before pickup to speed things up.
client.returnReminder:
Booking {code}: return the bike in 12 hours, by {end}.
Address: {address}
client.overdue: Booking {code}: the return time ({end}) has passed. A late fee of {hourlyFee} per hour applies. Please return the bike or contact the manager: {contact}.
client.expired: Booking {code} was not paid in time and has been released.
client.refunded: Refund of {amount} for booking {code} has been sent. Bank transfers can take a few banking days.
client.rate: Thanks for riding with us! How was booking {code}? Open the app to rate the trip.
client.returnReminder2h:
Booking {code}: your rental ends in 2 hours. Please return the bike by {end}.
Address: {address}
client.replacementOffer: Instead of the bike for booking {code}, the location offers {model}, plate {plate}. Open the booking to accept or cancel with a full refund.
client.bikeFound: Booking {code}: the manager confirmed the bike is here. Go to the desk: {address}. If you still cannot find it, report again in the app.
client.bikeMissingCancelled: Sorry, the bike was not at the location. Booking {code} is cancelled and we will return {refund}. More bikes are in the app.
client.bikeMissingWait: The location has not answered about booking {code} yet. We are on it. You can wait or cancel with a full refund in the app.
client.rubTransferNotFound: We can't find your transfer for booking {code} yet. Check the amount and details, or message the manager. We'll hold the booking a little longer.
client.documentRejected: {type}: document rejected. Upload a new photo in the app.

manager.cancelled:
Booking {code} is cancelled, the bike is free again.
{model}, {start} - {end}
manager.paymentMismatch: Payment amount mismatch for booking {code}: expected {expected}, received {received}. Status: Problem.
manager.paymentAfterCancel: Payment for booking {code} arrived after cancellation ({amount}). A refund is needed.
manager.bikeMoving:
ALERT: bike {plate} ({model}) is moving without a rental, speed {speed} km/h.
Map: {mapUrl}
manager.bikeReassigned: The previous customer has not returned the bike. Booking {code} moved to bike {plate}.
manager.bikeMissingCancelled: Booking {code} cancelled: bike not at the location. Return {refund} to the customer and mark the refund in Payments.

admin.denied: This command is for rental staff only.
admin.payosChanged: {name} changed the payment account of a location: {address}. Customer money there now follows the new settings.
admin.loginDone: Sign-in confirmed. Go back to the admin page: it will open by itself.
admin.loginExpired: This link has expired. Open the sign-in page again.
admin.loggedOut: All admin sessions are closed. You can sign in again from the sign-in page.
admin.documentsToCheck: New booking {code}, client {client}: {count} document(s) to check. See Documents in the admin panel.

bookings.hint: Use the buttons below to see your bookings and return dates.
bookings.more: Showing the first {count}. The rest are in the app.

empty.ending: You have no bike on rent right now.
empty.endingStaff: No bikes are on rent right now.
